principle: Features derive only from authoritative ICD terminology structure, official descriptions/provenance, and frozen candidate-set structure; no GEM membership or labels.

features.name: source_depth_norm
features.definition: source depth divided by maximum source-ontology depth
features.provenance: prefix hierarchy over authoritative ICD-9-CM code universe
features.missing: 0 with audit flag; missing is a preflight blocker for production universe

features.name: target_depth_norm
features.definition: target depth divided by maximum target-ontology depth
features.provenance: prefix hierarchy over official ICD-10-CM code universe
features.missing: 0 with audit flag; production missingness is blocked

features.name: target_sibling_count_log1p
features.definition: log(1 + count of ontology nodes sharing target parent)
features.missing: 0 only when parent is root/unknown; unknown parent is audited

features.name: target_ancestor_count_norm
features.definition: target ancestor-chain length divided by target maximum depth

features.name: candidate_same_parent_fraction
features.definition: fraction of frozen candidates sharing target parent
features.provenance: frozen candidate identities plus target parent links
features.missing: 0 for empty/unknown parent; empty candidate groups are blocked

features.name: candidate_same_family_fraction
features.definition: fraction of frozen candidates sharing target three-character family
features.provenance: target family derived from code structure

features.name: candidate_shared_ancestor_fraction
features.definition: fraction of frozen candidates sharing at least one target ancestor with target

features.name: candidate_same_root_fraction
features.definition: fraction of frozen candidates in target root branch

excluded_families.H2_ancestor_semantic_compatibility: excluded in R1 because no frozen ancestor encoder/cache was already committed; may be a separately preregistered future variant
